findings.claim: Controller result gate can never pass: raw JSON.stringify equality between wrapper-reported command (forward-slash NODE/NPM literals) and controller expected array (path.join -> backslashes on win32)
findings.evidence: run-static-cli-r2.cjs:7 (node:path), :12-14 (RUNTIME/NODE/NPM via path.join), :239-241 (cliArgs), :541 (JSON.stringify comparison, no normalization; normalized() at :64 unused here); static-primary-wrapper-r1.cjs:10-11 (forward-slash literals), :19-24 (commandFor), :68 (record.command verbatim)
findings.consequence: every exit-0 run of any mode ends EXACT_CLI_RESULT_REFUSED / FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE; fail-closed, no false pass; profile cannot produce its receipts
findings.smallestCorrection: controller only: compare path elements under normalized() on both sides, or define NODE/NPM as the wrapper's forward-slash literals; re-pin controller, pins file and parent $qualExpected hash; wrapper and pure36 unchanged
findings.provingCheck: pure control that builds the controller's expected array as the controller does for all three modes and asserts the controller's comparison succeeds against commandFor(mode); fails at 68f738, passes after correction; then one actual run per mode under its own admission
findings.notCaughtByPure36: pure36 asserts commandFor(mode)[0] === ack.executablePath (wrapper literal), never the controller comparison

acceptedMechanism.readyAtomic: wx + rename; refuses pre-existing ready/ack/result; controller waits <=30s and validates pid/ppid/mode/candidate/tree/wrapper hash/workStopAt/startedAt window
acceptedMechanism.ackFromOsObservation: owned depth-0 row with pinned node exe via identity helper; ACK fields pid/parentPid/creationTicks/createdUtc/executablePath/observedUtc/workStopAt; wx + rename; refuses existing ACK
acceptedMechanism.wrapperGate: exact 12-key set, protocol, mode, candidate, tree, own digest, own pid/ppid, pinned node path, same workStopAt, ticks==createdUtc, created in [start-30s,start], observed in [start,now], now<stop, now-start<=30s; ACK file regular/non-symlink/<=4KiB/realpath; ACK_DEADLINE exit 1
acceptedMechanism.oneCommand: commandFor: three modes else CLI_MODE_REFUSED; started flag -> SECOND_CLI_REFUSED; protection literal 79414143/8e85daa; production-state XENIOS_EXPECTED_* only, no XENIOS_OBSERVED_*
acceptedMechanism.resultBinding: cli-result.json wx; controller requires protocol/mode/candidate/tree/wrapperPid==child.pid/wrapper hash/ackSha256==digest(ack)/observedPrimary byte-equal/exit 0/no signal/within window/startedUtc>=observedUtc
acceptedMechanism.envPinsBudgets: allowlisted env, NPM_CONFIG_OFFLINE, heap 1024, inherited NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH refused, bin-shadow refused, 92 pins pre/post, source clean/non-shallow pre/post, npm 10.8.2 pre/post, 180s work + 60s cleanup = 240s, zero retries, two quiet observations, exact pid+ticks kills only
acceptedMechanism.parentScript: ticket hash, exact invocation array, finite window <=20 min, lastStart=end-270s, fresh outputs, pre/post pins, no competing qualification processes, 1536 MiB floor x3, cleared env, no force-kill
